# Role detail
{: .no_toc }

View or edit a role's permissions.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ROL-02` |
| **Route** | `/admin/roles/:roleId` · deep link `substratal://admin/roles/:roleId` |
| **Where** | Administration › Roles |
| **Who can use it** | users.list (read), roles.manage (write) |
| **Kind** | detail |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | Content pane; `AdwViewSwitcher`; header-bar actions |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Header | name, id-chip, scope, assignment_count |  |  | GtkLabel .monospace + copy |
| Description | text-field | Role.description | read-only when seed | AdwEntryRow |
| Permissions | checkbox-list grouped by prefix | Role.permissions ⊂ Permission[].key | read-only when seed; show Permission.description | AdwPreferencesGroup of check rows |
| Holders | link | → USR-01 filtered by `GET /users?role_id={id}` | explicit assignments only; for an app's `default_app_role`, add "and everyone with access to {app}" → ACX-05 filtered | GtkButton .flat / GtkLinkButton |
| Delete role | destructive-button | DELETE /roles/{id} | only non-seed with assignment_count 0 | GtkButton .destructive-action |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Save | `PATCH /roles/{id} {description, permissions} (If-Match)` |  |
| Delete | `DELETE /roles/{id}` | 409 → still assigned |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES

## For developers

Loads: `GET /roles/{id}` · `GET /permissions?scope`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
